page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin (partly cut off by the binding and the neighbouring page edge). Running head at top. Closing italic lines centred below the text. A catchword-like line at the foot right is not clearly legible.

main_text.l: escam, & illum bibere potum, in Christo
manere & illum manentem in se habere. Qui
autem per hoc qui non manet in Christo, & in
quo non manet Christus, procul dubio
nec manducat spiritualiter carnem ejus, nec
tantum Sacramentum ad judicium sibi manducat
non digne sumit, nisi qui mundus est.
Atque hinc dicit, secundum quendam modum
sanguinem Christi esse Epist. 23. Hac ergo
ejus, non revera. Hanc rem fuse & eleganter
